desc:
BUILD A BASE WITH FRIENDS AND DOMINATE -> 🧟 SURVIVE THE HORDE 🛡️

The horde is coming. Can your base survive the night?

Build a deadly arsenal of guns, tower, and hold the line against MASSIVE waves of zombies. Drop cannons, snipers, tesla coils, and traps — upgrade them mid-battle. Last as long as you can solo, or team up with friends and defend together.

Every wave gets harder. How deep can you push before the horde tears you down?

⚔️ FEATURES

🧟 30+ escalating enemies — BOMBERS, BALLOONS, GIANTS, UFOs… and MONSTROUS BOSSES
🏰 20+ unique towers — Crossbows, Tesla Coils, Molten Cannons, Spike Traps, Troop Tents & more
🔫 Fight back yourself with 25+ weapons, from trusty Revolvers to room-clearing Miniguns
💪 Pick a Class with unique perks built around your playstyle
🌙 NIGHTMARE MODE — tougher zombies, 3× the gems (if you can survive it)
🤝 Co-op multiplayer — hold the base with your friends
🎁 Battle Pass, daily rewards & lucky
